notes.title: Update Alpha 0.7.3.9.3
notes.content:
Added a max health regeneration indicator.
 Fixed an issue where max health regeneration could restore full HP, even after falling below the maximum.
 Added a dropdown for sprint mode (hold, toggle, and auto).
 Changed the lock-on sphere size.
 The attack queue should now properly reset on ragdoll. Attacks can be queued when the recovery animation starts.

notes.title: UPDATE VERSION: Alpha 0.7.3.7
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this post mainly serves as a test for an upcoming feature in the game. I probably won't bother to write patch notes for every update during closed alpha.

Added new Ability (Fireball throw) for Hades
Fixed an issue with the authentication system
A bunch of smaller bugfixes
